parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The name of the dataset. For more information, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The configuration of the notification message. For more information, click Notification. For more information about the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification messages](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. For more information, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The custom tags that are used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom information. This information is returned in the asynchronous notification message to help you associate the message with your system. The value can be up to 2,048 bytes in length.
